mapper.update: UPDATE cut_task SET current_assessment_id = #{query.assessmentId}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.taskId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND current_assessment_id IS NULL AND task_origin = 'NEW_PLATFORM' AND current_stage = 'P2' AND task_status = 'GRADE_CONFIRMING' AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE cut_task SET current_assessment_id = #{query.assessmentId}, manual_grade = #{query.manualGrade}, current_stage = #{query.currentStage}, task_status = #{query.taskStatus}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.taskId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND task_origin = 'NEW_PLATFORM' AND current_stage = 'P2' AND task_status = 'GRADE_CONFIRMING' AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE cut_task SET current_stage = 'P4', task_status = 'PLAN_DRAFTING', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.taskId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND task_origin = 'NEW_PLATFORM' AND current_stage = 'P3' AND task_status = 'SURVEYING' AND manual_grade IN ('A', 'B', 'C') AND deleted = b'0'
